# QuickJSR

A portable, lightweight, zero-dependency JavaScript engine for R, using
[QuickJS](https://bellard.org/quickjs/).

Values and objects are directly passed between R and QuickJS, with no
need for serialization or deserialization. This both reduces overhead
and allows for more complex data structures to be passed between R and
JavaScript - including functions.

## Installation

You can install the development version of QuickJSR from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("andrjohns/QuickJSR")
```

Or you can install pre-built binaries from R-Universe:

``` r

install.packages("QuickJSR", repos = c("https://andrjohns.r-universe.dev",
                                        "https://cran.r-project.org"))
```

## Usage

For standalone or simple JavaScript code, you can use the
[`qjs_eval()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/qjs_eval.md)
function:

``` r

library(QuickJSR)

qjs_eval("1 + 1")
#> [1] 2
qjs_eval("Math.random()")
#> [1] 0.816737
```

For more complex interactions, you can create a QuickJS context and
evaluate code within that context:

``` r

ctx <- JSContext$new()
```

Use the `$source()` method to load JavaScript code into the context:

``` r

# Code can be provided as a string
ctx$source(code = "function add(a, b) { return a + b; }")

# Or read from a file
subtract_js <- tempfile(fileext = ".js")
writeLines("function subtract(a, b) { return a - b; }", subtract_js)
ctx$source(file = subtract_js)
```

Then use the `$call()` method to call a specified function with
arguments:

``` r

ctx$call("add", 1, 2)
#> [1] 3
ctx$call("subtract", 5, 3)
#> [1] 2
```

### Interacting with R objects, environments, and functions

As QuickJSR uses the respective C APIs of R and QuickJS to pass values
between the two, this allows for more complex data structures to be
passed between R and JavaScript.

For example, you can also pass R functions to be evaluated using
JavaScript arguments:

``` r

ctx$source(code = "function callRFunction(f, x, y) { return f(x, y); }")
ctx$call("callRFunction", function(x, y) x + y, 1, 2)
#> [1] 3
ctx$call("callRFunction", function(x, y) paste0(x, ",", y), "a", "b")
#> [1] "a,b"
```

You can pass R environments to JavaScript, and both access and update
their contents:

``` r

env <- new.env()
env$x <- 1
env$y <- 2

ctx$source(code = "function accessEnv(env) { return env.x + env.y; }")
ctx$call("accessEnv", env)
#> [1] 3

ctx$source(code = "function updateEnv(env) { env.z = env.x * env.y; return env.z;}")
ctx$call("updateEnv", env)
#> [1] 2

env$z
#> [1] 2
```

QuickJSR also provides a global `R` object, which you can use to access
objects and functions from various R packages:

``` r

qjs_eval('R.package("base")["Sys.Date"]()')
#> [1] "2026-08-21 08:00:00 AWST"
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`js_script_run()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/JSCompiledScript.md)
  [`js_script_run_ref()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/JSCompiledScript.md)
  : Compile and repeatedly execute JavaScript
- [`assign()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/JSContext-method-assign.md)
  : Assign a value to a variable in the current context
- [`call()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/JSContext-method-call.md)
  : Call a JS function in the current context
- [`eval()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/JSContext-method-eval.md)
  : Evaluate code in a persistent JavaScript context
- [`get()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/JSContext-method-get.md)
  : Get a variable from the current context
- [`source()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/JSContext-method-source.md)
  : Evaluate JS string or file in the current context
- [`validate()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/JSContext-method-validate.md)
  : Assess validity of JS code without evaluating
- [`new_JSContext()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/JSContext-new.md)
  : Create a JavaScript context
- [`call_ref()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/JSContext-reference-methods.md)
  [`get_ref()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/JSContext-reference-methods.md)
  [`eval_ref()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/JSContext-reference-methods.md)
  : Create persistent JavaScript references
- [`JSContext`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/JSContext.md)
  : JSContext object
- [`js_ref_get()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/JSValueRef.md)
  [`js_ref_call()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/JSValueRef.md)
  [`js_ref_to_r()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/JSValueRef.md)
  : Persistent JavaScript value references
- [`QuickJSR-package`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/QuickJSR-package.md)
  [`QuickJSR`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/QuickJSR-package.md)
  : The QuickJSR package.
- [`from_json()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/from_json.md)
  : from_json
- [`js_columnar_data_frame()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/js_columnar_data_frame.md)
  : Transfer a data frame as an object of columns
- [`js_masked_typed_array()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/js_masked_typed_array.md)
  : Transfer missing typed values with a validity mask
- [`js_mutable_view()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/js_mutable_view.md)
  : Expose owned R vector storage as a mutable JavaScript view
- [`js_readonly_view()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/js_readonly_view.md)
  : Expose an R vector as a read-only JavaScript view
- [`js_ref_to_altrep()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/js_ref_to_altrep.md)
  : Create an R ALTREP view over a JavaScript typed array
- [`js_typed_array()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/js_typed_array.md)
  : Transfer an R vector as a JavaScript typed array
- [`qjs_eval()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/qjs_eval.md)
  : qjs_eval
- [`cppflags()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/quickjs_flags.md)
  [`ldflags()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/quickjs_flags.md)
  : QuickJS-NG Compiler and Linker Flags
- [`quickjs_version()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/quickjs_version.md)
  : Get the version of the bundled QuickJS library
- [`to_json()`](https://andrjohns.github.io/QuickJSR/reference/to_json.md)
  : to_json
